Case study · UI and motion design

Sunrise Moments: an advent calendar that doubled its registrations.

24 days of quizzes and prizes for customers of Sunrise, a Swiss telecom. In three days I redesigned the calendar and animated every asset, and the new edition drew twice as many quiz registrations as the year before, with organic distribution only.

ClientSunrise · Swiss telecom
RoleUI design and animation, at DECODE
TeamMe and one developer
EditionAdvent 2025
Timeline3 days of design · 1 week of development and QA
LanguagesEnglish, German, French and Italian
ScopeCalendar and quiz UI · Desktop and mobile · Animated illustrations · Lottie export for development
sunrise.ch

Scroll inside the window to see the whole page

The challenge

A fresh calendar on top of last year's engine.

The new design had to fit the previous edition's logic and backend exactly, so the developer only needed to write a new front end. Every window, quiz step and result state had to map onto what was already there.

The approach

Design within the logic

I kept the existing flow and states and redesigned everything people see: 24 patterned gift windows, the prize reveals, the quiz and the result screens.

Animation, start to finish

I animated all the assets myself and exported them with LottieFiles as JSON, so they stayed light and were easy for the developer to drop in.

Designed in German

If it works in German, it works everywhere.

The calendar launched in four languages for a Swiss audience. I designed every screen in German, because its words run around 30% longer than in the other languages, so any layout that held up in German would hold up in English, French and Italian too. Once the build was on staging, I checked every screen in all four languages.

The quiz flow

Each day starts with today's prize and a quick email sign-up, then one question. People find out instantly whether they were right, learn a "did you know" fact, and land on a result screen: entered into the prize pool, or better luck tomorrow. Both end with an invitation to share the quiz.

On mobile

Ten windows at a time, the rest a tap away.

On phones the calendar shows the first ten days with a "Load more" button, keeping the page short and fast while the how-to-play steps stay one scroll below.

Results

173,127quiz registrations in the first 5 days
2×last year's registrations by the end of Advent
100%organic distribution, no paid media
